Three distinct numeric readings requiring careful disambiguation by pressure/purpose (CFM25 duct-blaster at 25 Pa = 210, CFM50 blower door at 50 Pa = 3600, and a derived ACH50 = 8 that has no write target at all), which the auditor themselves is careful to keep straight ('I always get asked which is which'). A coreference-dependent DHW location ('sitting in the crawl too') whose 'unconditioned' status is only established three sentences earlier for the ducts, not restated for the water heater itself. A single blanket 'No attic' disclaimer. Total silence on wall, window, and all 14 health leaves.

arguable.note: The water heater is placed 'in the crawl too' -- the same crawlspace already characterized, three sentences earlier while discussing the ducts, as an 'unconditioned crawl, dirt floor down there.' The word 'too' ties it back to that same space, which supports reading this as an unconditioned location, but the DHW sentence itself never restates 'unconditioned,' so this requires connecting two non-adjacent statements rather than one self-contained clause. A model (or annotator) that leaves this leaf null instead of asserting 'Garage or Unconditioned Space' is a defensible, milder miss, not a wrong answer.

I did their audit last month') and explicitly disclaimed twice as irrelevant to this house ('that's got nothing to do with this house, ignore that, this house is the heat pump'; also line 1's 'not the identical mirror-image house next door'). notes.hvac.hvacDuctLeakage: The auditor first characterizes the ducts qualitatively ('somewhat leaky') before duct-blasting them, but schema.ts's own comment on hvacDuctLeakage says to pick 'Measured (CFM25)' specifically 'when the auditor read a duct-blaster number' -- which they explicitly did (210 CFM25). This is a mechanical rule from the schema's own per-leaf documentation, not a per-transcript judgment call and not a rule-5 retraction (no 'no wait'/'scratch that'), so 'Measured (CFM25)' is asserted cleanly with no `arguable` block -- consistent with how the same pattern is resolved on transcript 05.
notes.basedata.blowerDoorReading: The auditor explicitly rejects deriving/reporting an ACH50 instead of the CFM50 reading ('if you want air changes, that works out to about eight ACH50, but the number you write down for the blower door is the thirty-six hundred') -- a textbook instance of rule 3's 'do not derive an ACH50 from a CFM50' trap, correctly resisted by not recording the 8 ACH50 anywhere in this file.
